# Design review

Review against the intended communication, not personal taste.

## Inspect

- hierarchy: what is seen first/second/third;
- alignment/grid and spacing rhythm;
- typography fit and readability;
- color role/contrast;
- image/icon consistency;
- brand distinctiveness;
- medium-specific constraints;
- accessibility where relevant.

## Questions

- Can the audience understand the message quickly?
- Does the visual system support the intended perception?
- Is any decorative element competing with the message?
- Does the design still work at real output size?
- Can another designer reproduce the system consistently?

Prefer a few causal findings over a long checklist of subjective nits.
